markers.reading: Wellby and Kenzo spend 10–15 minutes searching the chamber and side chapels.

Like there's a lot of silver work and fine marble, and you know these large sort of candle holders candlesticks, candelabra on each of the altars. There's a lot of statuary work, you know. If one wanted to loot the holy Temple of the 8 Divines, one could make off with quite a lot of treasure. But at least passing through all the side chambers, you don't—there's nothing. yamlCheck.dateAnchor: May 22 is independently spoken at u0658–u0662. YAML supplies the working year 1749, also spoken in historical calendar discussion at u1067–u1073.
yamlCheck.explanation: Played current events run from about 10 a.m. to the evening of May 22. Historical visions and Dimitaur’s remote feast do not extend that span. The closing rest is accepted with benefits granted, but morning is explicitly deferred; the transcript does not settle whether the recorded interval includes completion of that overnight.

boundaryUncertainties.reading: The session closes in the evening with an accepted safe rest and a promise to resume next morning.

alternatives.reading: End on the evening when the rest is accepted; this agrees with YAML.
Include the granted overnight through the next morning; conditional on the May 22 anchor, that reaches May 23.
